svg.title: Who reads the layout file
svg.desc: The Pecos YAML is found by name, parsed once into a Layout, turned into a PoseGraph, a GarageGraph and a CollisionTable, and then read by the scheduler, the motion planner, the action graph, the safety checker, the tape tool and the GetGarageLayout message. Arrow labels name the fields that flow.

g.text: GetMD5Sum itself is not in the snapshots. Pecos counts: 60 poses, 164 directed GarageGraph edges (148 translations, 16 rotations).

g.text: The layout YAML is looked up by name, parsed once into a Layout, and expanded into three derived structures. Arrow labels name the fields that flow; in each reader, L, GG and CT mark what it reads from the Layout, the GarageGraph and the CollisionTable.
